title: Forno — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Forno.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Flair, Everyday Price." Forno brings Italian-inspired design to the value pro-style segment. Stainless steel construction, brass burners on select models, and European styling. Positioned between Thor Kitchen and Bertazzoni in both price and design.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Buyers who want Italian design cues without Italian luxury pricing. Kitchen remodels on a budget.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Forno:

• Italian-inspired design at mid-range pricing

• Brass burner options on select models — unusual at this price

• European styling differentiates from American pro-style

• Growing dealer and online presence

• Full-size pro-style at prices under $3,000
